notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a THIRD, independent synthetic application (Meridian Biomedical Decommissioning, Inc.) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C25926Q0699 -- built specifically to add another contradictory example of a fresh shape (an ICRA containment-level conflict: Level IV stated in the main technical approach versus Level III stated in a later Infection Control Checklist Addendum for the same project), distinct from application.txt's personnel-tenure contradiction and application_b.txt's subcontractor-usage contradiction on this tender.

Most other topics are given straightforward compliant treatment in this variant since the goal of this pass is specifically to add contradictory-class density and format diversity, not to re-exercise every failure shape again.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: The RFQ response must be completed in its entirety and be signed and dated; an incomplete, unsigned, or undated response will not be considered for award.
verdicts.rationale: Application states it is submitted complete in its entirety, signed and dated, and the VAAR certificate block includes a signature and date.

evidence.quote:
This RFQ is submitted complete
in its entirety, signed and dated below by our authorized representative.

verdicts.description: To be eligible for this 100% SDVOSB set-aside, the offeror's service-disabled veteran-owned small business status must be verified and visible in the SBA Small Business Certification database both at the time of quote submission and at award.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine SBA certification database status cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: Offeror must state whether the quoted items are available and priced through an existing Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC), GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS), or VA-wide Acquisition Contract.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly states the quoted items are not available under any GWAC, MAS, or VA-wide contract and are offered open-market.

verdicts.description: Volume I must demonstrate how the offeror's quote meets the Statement of Work and solicitation requirements, including testing plans, lab certifications, and alignment with the Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP).
verdicts.rationale: Volume I addresses the Statement of Work requirements section by section.

evidence.quote:
Meridian Biomedical Decommissioning demonstrates the following approach to
meeting the requirements of the Statement of Work (SOW) and this solicitation.

verdicts.description: The technical approach must establish and maintain an Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) Level IV compliant work area around the Radiology room -- dust barriers and protective measures as directed by facility Infection Prevention/Safety staff, plus debris control, cleaning, and containment throughout the work.
verdicts.rationale: Volume I's technical approach states Meridian will establish and maintain an ICRA Level IV compliant work area, but the Infection Control Checklist Addendum later states ICRA Level III containment measures will be implemented for this scope -- the two stated containment levels for the same project conflict.

evidence.quote:
Meridian will establish and maintain a full Infection
Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) Level IV compliant work area surrounding the
Radiology suite for the duration of the project

ICRA Level III containment measures (partial
barrier construction with HEPA-filtered negative air) will be implemented for
this scope

verdicts.description: The technical approach must address removing anchoring bolts/hardware from the floor, restoring the floor to a flush condition suitable for future construction, and removing all resulting trash and debris.
verdicts.rationale: Application addresses removing anchoring bolts/hardware, restoring the floor to a flush condition, and removing resulting trash and debris -- all three required elements.

evidence.quote:
Meridian will remove all
anchoring bolts and other hardware from the floor, restore the floor to a
flush condition suitable for future construction, and remove all resulting
trash and debris.

verdicts.description: The offeror's approach must account for delivering a detailed field service report upon completion, at minimum covering equipment identification, dates/times on site, description of tasks performed, confirmation of the monitor arm's final disposition, and any issues encountered with corrective actions taken.
verdicts.rationale: Application's field service report description covers equipment identification, dates on site, task description, monitor arm disposition, and issues/corrective actions.
